title: Current-host CPU readback document structures
$comment: These closed structural schemas are necessary, not sufficient. Provider/probe enforce actual own source root, immutable source/host/dependency/method roles, exact paths/complete inventories, clean Git, time-of-use checks, and independently supplied expected config digest. Canonical serialization is sorted ASCII JSON with separators comma/colon and no nonfinite values. Fresh host observation and full runtime qualification are later Gate H work. Source trees and complete installation rules are described in PROVIDER-IMPLEMENTATION.md. Job has no schema member to preserve the original helper body.

scope.const: Three original synthetic CPU cases only; twelve native slots are structural, never execution authority
